The structure of this project [[56]] is modelled by organic sources such as Human Conversation [[105]] and Natural Language [[99]].

In the context of this project, the Flattened Graph is essentially a single axis of unfolding paths. It is a significant structure throughout this System [[38]] and in Lzhalia's System Theory [[27]] We may even experience life experientially as a form of paths... the "Flattened Graph" essentially captures many organic structures including "[[]] Selective Hiearchies", "[[]] Unfolding Paths"
